ns2:section.sectionText: Online and Continuing Education (OCE) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.oce.illinois.edu. Video lectures, course materials, and a discussion board will be made available online through CITES Wiki. Students are expected to complete online assignments and examinations on ACE Organic as outlined in the syllabus. Discussion sessions will be conducted online using Collaborate/Elluminate at the indicated time. Participation in the live discussion session is recommended; discussions will also be recorded and archived online. This section has one or more proctored exams which may carry additional fees.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC or NDEG:Undergrad Nondeg-CE-UIUC.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: Graduate - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $387.00 per Bill Hour, Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $353.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $50.00 per Bill Hour.
